title: at handle register inscription body
description: JSON inscription body only. Plain text @handle needs no JSON. The same bytes in an OP_RETURN, including AT1|reg|…, are not a registration. p must be at — dns and dx bodies are not handles.

op.description: reg is an alias of register. config and primary are different inscriptions.

name.description: @ plus 1..15 characters, or the localpart alone. Letters from any script may mix, so @犬jon, @jo犬n, and @jon犬 are handles, and @Ðoge is not @doge. Also [0-9_], one Extended_Pictographic scalar, one flag, one ZWJ picture, one skin-tone emoji, one keycap, one subdivision flag, one currency sign, or one non-ASCII number. Each of those pictures is one character and is not the emoji it is built from. Canonical form adds @ and lowercases ASCII only. Count characters, not bytes. A dot, a lone regional indicator, a stray joiner, or a combining mark is invalid.

cname.description: Another @ handle, not a DNS name.

lightning.description: user@host or lnurl1…. A record value, not a second registration.
